slices.focus: Tense meeting: Jae-hyun defends board and preserves core coding logic.
slices.summary: An overnight operations meeting turns tense as Captain Lee Sang-ho argues board photos make crews look guilty by default. Jae-hyun arrives with printed comparisons showing weather delays separated from avoidable ones. The compromise: keep the board through summer but add a handwritten captain note line, preserving the weather-versus-avoidable coding that makes the data meaningful.
open_loops: Note line becoming a shield vs genuine context
decisions: Park Jae-hyun is still dispatch manager, and after an overnight challenge from vessel crews he kept the shared dispatch-
